description: Electric Power Substations in Myanmar is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU). Non-authoritative dataset of 300 approximate centre point locations of of electricity transmission and distribution substations as of 2025. Produced by CDE Myanmar based on publicly available reference data (incl. OpenStreetMap, local knowledge and high resolution satellite imagery. Coverage: Myanmar. The portal files it under the publisher Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU). Its tags are geodata, populated places-settlements. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
